name: Stepp2p
fix_description: In cancelSaleOrder, the refund logic returns both the remaining amount and the sell fee from feeAccount. This allows attackers to create a sale (paying fee), then immediately cancel to receive back both the deposit and the fee — profiting from the fee refund. Fix: do not refund fees on cancel, or track actual fees paid vs refundable separately. Also set sale.remaining = 0 after cancel.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, obvious business-logic double-spend: create a sale order, then call cancelSaleOrder and modifySaleOrder on the same saleId to receive funds twice. The PoC is minimal, uses only a simple flash loan for capital, and requires little protocol-specific or DeFi complexity to reproduce.
